notes: 13 searches. Removed: `rash` symptom link (no source ties acne to rash; NHS mentions rash only as an isotretinoin side effect), which left one relationship group, so the page was NOT publishable; added the `physiology: [hormones]` link (supported: NHS/BAD name hormone change as a major cause) to reach two groups and the checker ends ok. If the maintainer prefers no extra link, the page would be noindex. Kept aliases 'spots' (NHS 'Acne (spots)' hosted titles) and 'pimples' (MedlinePlus: 'acne ... causes pimples') and the related link to polycystic-ovary-syndrome (BAD 2024 and NHS causes name PCOS). The isotretinoin 'specialist doctor only' line is attributed to the NHS; NICE notes accredited GPs on agreed pathways can start it since Oct 2023, and that sentence is deliberately kept out. Remaining doubts: lesion-type descriptions come from an NHS Wales leaflet (111.wales.nhs.uk); 'acne cannot be passed on' and the 2 to 4 months / 12-week timings came from summaries that blend pages; the NICE 'continuum' and referral wording was read through search summaries of NG198, not the full page. Textbook sentences: 999 and NHS 111/Samaritans signposting only. Note: first-pass sentences 79/80/105 overlap and were merged into one NICE referral sentence.
